title: ledger_fold_advance event payload v0.2 (FUS-LEDGER-FOLD-STATE)
description: ADR-0010 §14.26 / LEDGER_FOLD_STATE_CACHE_DESIGN §3.3: a mechanical action-ledger fold advance at the loop-top gap (zero model calls) — the loop folded the next complete old rounds into the frozen ledger block when the ESTIMATED request view reached fold_trigger_tokens (default 128K). The request-view prefix is rewritten once per fold window (the accepted per-window prefix-cache miss), so the event carries the new fold point, the folded-round count and the triggering view estimate for cache-miss attribution. Emitted ONLY on a real advance (never on anti-spin no-ops). fold_start is the preamble end (first tool declaration, set at the first advance and constant within a window); fold_cut is the new verbatim-retention start — within a fold window fold_cut is strictly increasing and fold_start constant; a context_compressed event resets the fold state (indices re-accumulate from the marker). rounds_folded = complete rounds covered by the ledger after this advance. agent_role is the lane (main/internal_retrieval/external_retrieval — same enum as request_header_change). GAP-EVENT-SCHEMA-DRIFT (2026-08-26): view_estimate_after 是推进后的请求视图估算（chars/2）——真实推进后视图估算必须回落到触发阈值之下，故 view_estimate_after < view_estimate_tokens 为事件面可核证不变量（推进前估算 ≥ 阈值、推进后 < 阈值）。

fold_start.description: Preamble end index (the first assistant tool declaration) — set at the first advance, constant until a compaction reset.

fold_cut.description: Closed-end index of the folded region; the verbatim retention region is [fold_cut..]. Strictly increases within a fold window.

rounds_folded.description: Complete tool rounds covered by the frozen ledger after this advance (all folded rows' round count).

view_estimate_tokens.description: The chars/2 estimate of the request view that triggered the advance (≈ the size of the one-time prefix rewrite).

view_estimate_after.description: The chars/2 estimate of the request view AFTER the fold rewrite — a real advance must reset it below the fold trigger (view_estimate_after < view_estimate_tokens).

agent_role.description: The agent lane whose loop advanced the fold.
